text_block_list.text:
A day off. I came to watch a Horse Girl 
marathon race held outside Tracen Academy, 
but……
(——BANG BANG BANG!!)

text_block_list.name: Event Staff Lady
text_block_list.text:
GOOOOAAAL!!!!! In 1st place is Nice 
Nature-san!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Phew. Turned out to be a total blowout, 
huh……!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ——Ah. H-Hey…… so you came to watch.
choice_data_list:
Yeah, I didn't know you were 
participating.

Yes, I didn't realize you were 
participating too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well…… yeah. Remember what Palmer-san told 
me the other day?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
That whole 'escaping from everyday life' 
thing. I thought I'd give it a shot.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
See…… this race has girls from outside the 
academy too. I figured running among a 
different crowd might give me a fresh 
change of pace——

text_block_list.name: Black-Haired Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *gasp*…… I lost…… Ugh…… so 
frustrating!!

text_block_list.name: Black-Haired Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
But you were amazing, Nature-san! Someday, 
I'm definitely going to beat you!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ……Huh?

text_block_list.name: Long-Haired Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I get how you feel, but isn't that 
pretty much impossible~?

text_block_list.name: Long-Haired Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Your specialty is sprint distances, after 
all. Wouldn't it be easier to just give up 
cleanly?

text_block_list.name: Black-Haired Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
No, I don't want to give up! I can't give 
up! Because this uncontrollable feeling 
inside me……

text_block_list.name: Black-Haired Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Is my heart and body screaming out that I 
want to win no matter what someday!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Heart…… screaming……

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
……I was definitely in peak condition 
today. And yet, to Teio again……!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Dammit…… dammit all……!! It's so 
unbelievably frustrating……!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ……I see. So that's what it was.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
This girl…… feels 'frustrated' and 'wants 
to win' precisely because she 'hasn't 
given up'.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Which means, back then…… When I lost to 
Teio in that race, I was also——

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ——Gah!? I-It's nothing!! Really!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*…… My face is burning…… Was I really 
that much of a sore loser……?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ……U-Um, hey. I kinda need some advice……

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Like…… a way to cool my head down, or 
something. Got any ideas……?

Out of nowhere, she asked for advice. What 
came to mind right then was——
choice_data_list: Let's run to empty your mind.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I see, get some sugar to calm down, huh? 
……Nice idea!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Heartburn be damned, I'm gonna 
eat, eat, and eat my heart out!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ma'am! One Carrot Patch Chocolate, and…… 
Give me a Fanfare Ramune too, please!

text_block_list.name: Candy Shop Lady
text_block_list.text:
Coming right up, Ne-chan. You sure are 
eating a lot today, though?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, just in that kind of mood~. If you 
have any other recommendations——

text_block_list.name: Black-Haired Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's Nature-san! Nothing beats sweet 
snacks after a workout, right~?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Huh!? You're the guys from earlier...!

text_block_list.name: Candy Shop Auntie
text_block_list.text:
Well now. Young ladies, are you friends of 
Nei-chan?

text_block_list.name: Long-Haired Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Nature-san was so amazing in today's 
marathon tournament~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
W-Whoa there... So that's how it's gonna 
be~...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—Forget cooling my head, this is just 
getting me even more heated up!

Despite grumbling this and that... Nice 
Nature ended up happily sharing snacks 
with everyone.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I-I see. Though doesn't that kinda sound 
like hot-blooded sports anime stuff...?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—Oh screw it, I'm down! I'm in just the 
right mood for that right now!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *wheeze*... Th-That was more 
exhausting than the marathon...
choice_data_list: I didn't think we'd go until sundown...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha~... Seriously, huh. Honestly, I'm 
the most surprised one here.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, after running this much, all those 
useless thoughts got blown right away.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Nah, you know. It just crossed my mind for 
a tiny second.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Like, hey— maybe I can actually run pretty 
decent after all? You know.

It seemed that while clearing her head, 
she managed to gain just that little bit 
of confidence.
